## What's new in 3.17.5: junk and treasure

- **Most items are junk now; the great ones are rare.** Like the games this one grew up on, how often
  an item turns up depends on how good it is. A curio room is far more likely to hold something weak
  or odd than something great, and the best items are a real find. About 90 items had their numbers
  cut, and many are now properly bad.
- **Fewer items.** Secret rooms, libraries, deal rooms, cursed rooms, chests and marked rocks give
  items less often, and shops stock one fewer. You still get a curio and a boss item every floor.
- **No more playstyles.** Every run starts with the character's own kit, and the character page is
  back on paper: portrait and ending marks, story, stats, hearts and starting items.
- **Safer teleports.** You land on open floor away from enemies, never on top of the boss or on the
  Pincushion's spikes. Teleporting into a locked curio room or shop opens its door, and teleporting
  into a crawlspace always leaves a way out.
- **Walk right up to rocks.** You used to stop a whole step short of a rock when walking down onto
  it; now your feet stop right at its edge, from above and below.
- **The Patient can always be hit.** No more untouchable moments; it has a lot more health instead.
- **Pixel wings.** Every pair of wings is pixel art now, and they flap.
- **The letter checklist is gone** from the corner of the screen.
